items.quote: I was inspired to play drums once I saw Jamah play them. I also appreciate how much confidence and help Jamah has given me.
Drumming makes me feel calm and happy. It makes me inspired and I am glad I have such a good teacher.
Music makes me feel happy and good. I became more confident and love to make rap with Jamah.
One day I hope to be a drummer just like Jamah, he makes it look easy.
My mentor helps me make sense of school stuff and life stuff. It is nice to have someone who really listens.
I have learned that it is okay to ask for help and that thinking things through makes it easier to solve problems.
I am learning to stop and think before I react. Now I try to calm down and talk about my frustrations instead.
It is not always about winning, it is about trying to be better every day.
I feel calm when I am with the horses. They are really patient and I can take my time without worrying about getting it wrong.
Being outside with the animals is fun and peaceful. I have learned to be more calm, patient and caring.
